verdict.rationale: Cekura documents automated cron jobs for scheduled testing and evaluation workflows (docs-13) and GitHub Actions CI/CD that tests agents on every change (docs-14). Incoming calls posted by webhook automatically get metric evaluation scheduled (docs-6), and the site claims continuous drift detection plus an automatic flag-reproduce-suggest-fix loop (docs-20, docs-21). Missing for 10: detail beyond one-line doc summaries on what cron jobs can trigger, scheduling options and failure handling; independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably unattended.
